name: Horikawa Nanase
source:
School: 1st-year Moriyoh Gakuen
Description: full of life
Profile: The most outgoing and energetic girl in the game.  She has a huge crush on the main character, so that works to your advantage if you choose her. She likes cooking and hopes that she can cook for the one she loves someday.
